meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 dial 命令行,通过一个已经配好的真实手机号发短信、发起 AI 语音通话,并等待、读取收到的短信或验证码。账号和凭据都已就绪,不需要你提供任何密钥。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、验证码等关键词,或让你发短信、打电话、等验证码时触发;在会话里第一次运行 dial 命令前也会先读它。

say.text: 给 +14155550123 发条短信:明天十点开会
say.note: Claude 走 dial message 发送

say.text: 给 +14155550123 打个电话,问问营业时间
say.note: 发起 AI 语音通话,结束后可查结果

say.text: 帮我等一条短信验证码

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses the dial CLI with a pre-provisioned real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and wait for and read inbound texts or codes. Credentials are injected; you configure nothing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, SMS, OTP, or verification codes; when you ask it to text, call, or wait for a code; or before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.note: Claude sends it via dial message

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 and ask about opening hours
say_en.note: AI voice call; check the result after it ends

say_en.text: Wait for an SMS verification code
